name: sql-server
description: Read-only SQL Server and Azure SQL Database access for agents, bounded by a read-only database principal (ADR 0086). This release ships the versioned config schema, its loader, the single-statement reject list, the stdio MCP server with its fixed query, list_objects and describe_object tools, the tedious executor with per-call transaction guards, and a setup skill that checks a config and registers each environment by reference.
